registered: before running; reference v9.5 2.976 [2.355, 3.832, 2.447]; family not tested before: intraday timing
conventions: hourly returns R[label t] = return over [t, t+1h); positions decided with information up to t; funding stamped at s is charged in the hour ending at s; 5 bp per side on position changes; each sleeve added to v9.5 through portfolio_v5 (equal risk)

trials.A intraday momentum BTC/ETH: per coin, r = return 00:00 -> 22:00 UTC of the day; hold 0.5 x sign(r) during 22:00-24:00 UTC, flat otherwise
trials.B hour-of-week seasonality BTC/ETH: per coin and hour-of-week, mean and t-stat of R over the previous 104 weeks (min 52, current week excluded); hold 0.5 x sign(mean) in that hour when |t| > 2, else flat
trials.C pre-funding fade, 6 majors: BTC ETH SOL XRP BNB DOGE; in the hour ending at each funding stamp (00/08/16 UTC), with f = the previous realised funding rate: -0.5 if f > 0.0002, +0.5 if f < 0, else flat (funding of the stamp is paid/received)
trials.D post-funding rebound, 6 majors: same coins; in the hour after each stamp, with f = the rate just stamped: +0.5 if f > 0.0002, -0.5 if f < 0, else flat

pass: strict rule vs v9.5 (2022-26 +0.05 and no period lower); with several passes the highest 2022-26 Sharpe; sleeve Sharpes reported per period
